blurb: Rowdy Boats offers captained party pontoon rentals on Percy Priest Lake with a capacity of up to 22 guests per boat. Rentals include a licensed captain, coolers, ice, water toys like lily pads and pool noodles, and a premium sound system. The standard cruise duration is 3 hours, with customizable packages for events like birthdays, bachelorette parties, and corporate outings.
